create_processor_bros: create a BrosProcessor instance with a tokenizer for document layout analysis
call_processor_bros: call the BrosProcessor to encode images and text into model input tensors
configure_bros_processor_kwargs: configure BrosProcessorKwargs with text tokenization defaults like add_special_tokens and padding
load_processor_bros: load a pre-trained BrosProcessor from a local directory or HuggingFace Hub model ID
save_processor_bros: save a BrosProcessor instance to a local directory for reuse in downstream pipelines
